intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A gull lands beside Nerelle, pulls a ribbon off a post, and drops it in the water in front of her.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “That is the gulls’ fourth petition this week.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Better decorations, they claim. Their actual demand is unattended crumbs.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I rejected the first three. They ate the third.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The gull is now staring at your pocket.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “A united front. The fish thank you.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The gull looks at your pocket, then at your face, and appears to memorize it.

options.labelText: “Aw, one crumb won’t hurt. It’s only one gull.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You toss one crumb. Nine more gulls arrive.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Congratulations. You have formally recognized their government.”
